title: Ready to Study Website
shortTitle: AI-assisted delivery for an education consultancy.
outcome: An education consultancy website built with AI-assisted development, chatbot integration and student enquiry pathways.
summary: A live website for Ready to Study, connecting study destinations, course exploration, services and adviser contact with AI-assisted development and chatbot support.
problem: Students need a clear way to explore study destinations, course options, admissions support and how to contact an education adviser.
Ready to Study serves students through counsellors in Sydney and Dhaka. The website brings those services and next steps into a single online experience.
role: Used AI-assisted development tools to build and refine the Ready to Study website.
Implemented chatbot support and AI-assisted tools as part of the client delivery, alongside the website’s course, destination, service and enquiry experience.
Connected the client’s education services with clear paths for students to explore options and reach the team.
